//: The measured cell and pinned font for this machine, and the design system's own self-contradictions. A contradiction is a bug in .claude/design/, removed when the design is fixed upstream — never when the app changes. See crates/review/src/baseline.rs.

contradictions.design_says: `Aldwin Agent TUI.dc.html` frame `3a` draws four options — `Allow once` / `Allow cargo test for this session` / `Always allow cargo * in this project` / `Deny and tell the agent why` — under the sentence `Aldwin wants to run a shell command.`, with the tool name `bash` right-flush on the title row, a `1-4 pick` hint and `saved to .aldwin/permissions.toml`. Its grid is `bar-top / 1fr / panel-permission (18) / bar-bottom (5)`: the panel sits *above* a bottom band reading `answer above to continue`.
contradictions.design_also_says: The same project's top-level README.md, corrected upstream on 2026-09-20 (see `.claude/design/IMPORT.md`): eight rows, allow and deny mirrored across once / session / project / everywhere; a grant is a program and a class (`cargo writes`), not a command pattern (`cargo *`); `There is no shell to run a command in`; the title's right-flush fact is the *program*; `Deny and tell the agent why` is gone because nothing collects a reason; and the footer names no file, because the old one `named the wrong file … and was true of three rows out of eight`. The README also records as an open question that eight rows do not fit the 18-row panel. The repaint redrew `3a` from a base older than that correction and resolved the open question by reverting to four rows.
contradictions.app_follows: ADR 0004, which the README describes and the frame does not. This is not a judgement call between two readings of a design: `No arbitrary commands` and `Default-deny` are non-negotiable constraints in CLAUDE.md, and the four-row list is the UI of the model ADR 0004 deleted — a `cargo *` row would be a control for a grant the engine cannot store. The app takes `3a`'s *tones* in full (title `text`, program `quiet`, `$` `quiet`, numbers `label`, footer keys `body`) and none of its copy. It also keeps the panel as the bottom band rather than stacking it on one: `3a`'s 18 + 5 rows close only because there are four options. Retire when `3a` is redrawn with eight rows — which is also when the panel-height question gets a real answer.

contradictions.design_says: Frame `1c` draws four access rows — `ask` / `read` / `write` / `all`, the last reading `everything runs · nothing asks` — and `1d`'s `access` fact is a bare tier word. Its open-step prose promises `/access changes it later`.
contradictions.design_also_says: The top-level README's first-run section reads `ask · read · write` — `Three points, not four` — because `full access had no distinct meaning to offer: editing a file always shows a diff and waits, under every rung, so no point on this scale can mean everything runs`. This entry used to say the four-point scale survived only in the bound copy's Turn 14 prose and that a re-sync would bring it forward. The re-sync came (2026-09-21) and went the other way: the repaint redrew the frame with four.
contradictions.app_follows: The README and ADR 0004 §3, which puts `edit` outside the permissions model. Three rungs, and the `access` fact reads the standing rung followed by `edits always ask`, the one thing no rung changes. `crates/tui/src/ui/first_run.rs`'s `no_access_row_claims_edits_run_unasked` fails on the string `nothing asks`, so the frame's fourth row cannot ship by accident. `/access` is dropped from the prose because no such command exists. Retire when `1c` is redrawn with three rows.

contradictions.design_says: The lantern-gold repaint replaced the token layer (`palette.css`, `semantic.css`: warm greys, one gold, four status hues, a two-hue syntax ramp, an `up-n`/`down-n` ground ladder) and collapsed three frame files into one `Aldwin Agent TUI.dc.html` with eleven frames numbered `1a`–`3c`.
contradictions.design_also_says: Neither prose document moved. README.md still opens `Five states are designed`, ids them `4a`/`5a`–`5d`, names `Agent TUI v2.dc.html` and its Light twin as the files, carries the single-hue OKLCH colour tables and a glyph table closed at `▌ ● ◐ ○ ✔ ▶ █ + -`, and writes the brand `mjolnir`. The bound copy's SYNC.md — the change record — ends at Turn 15 and has no entry for the repaint at all. Three entries that used to stand here were each one instance of this (`5a`'s recess in the prose but not the frame; screen prose naming ramp rungs the token layer does not expose; a glyph table that omitted marks its own copy mandated) and are folded in.
contradictions.app_follows: The frame and the tokens, per CLAUDE.md's first design rule. `.claude/design/HANDOFF.md` keeps the README's text with `>` annotations, and its `### Glyphs` table is *measured from the frame* rather than mirrored, because `crates/review`'s generator parses that table into `tokens.rs`. Retire when upstream rewrites README.md against the new frames and SYNC.md gains the repaint's entry.

contradictions.design_says: Frames `1a`–`1d` right-flush `config → ~/.aldwin/config.toml`; `3a` says `saved to .aldwin/permissions.toml`; `1c` and `2d` both name a `/access` command; `2a` hints `esc stop` and `2c` hints `esc clear`.
contradictions.design_also_says: The README states the answers land in `permissions.yaml` — `the project's .mjolnir/ … ~/.mjolnir/` — and lists the keyboard model as `esc closes an overlay or interrupts a run`, with nothing that clears a draft.
contradictions.app_follows: What exists. Config is YAML and is two files, so the footer reads `config → ~/.aldwin/`; there is no `/access`; a turn is cancelled with `^c`, which is what the status row says; and Esc is unbound in the composer, so `esc clear` is not drawn — a footer must not name a key that does something else, and a hint is not where a binding that destroys typed input gets introduced. Retire per item as each is either built or redrawn.

contradictions.design_says: README.md's session section — the inline diff carries `a 5-cell right-aligned line number`, which reads as the number ending at cell 7 when measured from the 3-cell margin.
contradictions.design_also_says: The frame's own markup (`2a`, and `2b`'s code block) is `flex: 0 0 var(--gutter-line-no-inline); text-align: right; padding-right: var(--cell-w)` — a 5-cell field holding a 4-cell number and one cell of separation, so the number right-aligns to cell 6 and cell 7 is the separation. It was `45px` / `9px` before the frames moved onto tokens; the geometry is unchanged.
contradictions.app_follows: The markup. This is the single most re-raised finding in the project's history — judges have reported it across four separate runs, each reading the prose and none reading the 45px. Kept here so the fifth does not.

contradictions.design_says: The glyph table contains no box-drawing characters, and nothing inside a frame is stroked.
contradictions.design_also_says: The design system has no table component at all, and a one-dimensional ground ladder cannot express a two-dimensional grid of cell boundaries.
contradictions.app_follows: ADR 0002 — a markdown table in assistant prose is drawn with `┌ ┬ ┐ ├ ┼ ┤ └ ┴ ┘ ─ │`, scoped to that one construct. This entry is retired when the design system gains a table component.

contradictions.design_says: `palette.css` pairs `--color-info` with `→` (`/* → */`). `cells.css` still declares `--wordmark-h`, and `1d`'s caption says `The mark identifies a frame with no transcript to identify it`. `semantic.css` names `--tui-context` for `unchanged lines in a diff`.
contradictions.design_also_says: `semantic.css` pairs `--tui-info` with `·` (`/* · the info line's pointer */`), and `2d` draws `·`. No frame draws a wordmark and nothing applies `--wordmark-h`, against `cells.css`'s own rule — `If you add a token here and nothing applies it, delete it instead`. `3c` draws its unchanged rows in `--tui-quiet`, and no frame reads `--tui-context` at all; nor `--tui-value`, `--tui-accent-text`, `--tui-gauge-fill-hot` or `--tui-scrim`.
contradictions.app_follows: `·` for the info pointer, as the frame draws it. No wordmark: the reverse-video row is gone from first run and the empty state, which retires the entry that stood here about its letters spelling the old name. `context` for an unchanged row of the *inline* diff, which is the role's stated purpose and which no frame contradicts — `3c` is the review pane, and it is not built. This is a bug list for the design system, not a set of choices: each clause retires when upstream deletes or applies the token.
